title: CR-LT-KGQA: A Knowledge Graph Question Answering Dataset Requiring Commonsense Reasoning and Long-Tail Knowledge
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark dataset that explicitly includes 'Religous' knowledge as a domain-specific reasoning skill (accounting for 10.5% of the question answering task and 7.3% of the claim verification task). The evaluation includes reasoning about religious entities and spiritual concepts, such as whether a specific job is considered 'holy'.
